lines: You. You are today. I have written you on the board.
Four down, one up, and the one up walked past this window an hour ago.
Do not let it go to your head. Actually, no. Let it. Go on.
We keep the board. Every challenger, every day, twenty-two years.
Best year we ever had was nine Crests. Worst was none at all.
Roxen was the Keeper for both of those years, before you ask.

sw_house_d_gran: I have got that map because my husband drew it and he drew it wrong.
Plates move. They have never moved. He could not push a stone straight
and he went to his grave saying the Hall shifted them at night.
Forty years I let him say it. What would you have done?
